description:
Water extent for Flood, Lao People's Democratic Republic, 23 July 2018 (FL20180723LAO): 197,987 features merged from 8 source layers. Polygon layers with a water class column (such as `Water_Class`), or whose names mention flood, water, or inundation: satellite-detected water. The `source_layer` and `source_file` columns name the layer and file each row came from.

From these HDX datasets:

- [Evolution satellite detected water extent over Sanamxay District, Attapeu Province, Lao People Democratic Republic](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/evolution-satellite-)
- [Evolution satellite detected water extent over Sanamxay District, Attapeu Province, Lao People Democratic Republic](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/evolution-satellite-detected-water-extent-over-)
- [Evolution satellite detected water extent over Sanamxay District, Attapeu Province, Lao People Democratic Republic](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/evolution-satellite-detected-water-extent-over-sanamxay-district-attapeu-province-lao-people-)
- [Satellite detected water extent as of 27 July 2018 over Sanamxay District, Attapeu Province, Lao PDR](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/satellite-detected-water-extent-as-)
- [Satellite detected water extent as of 27 July 2018 over Sanamxay District, Attapeu Province, Lao PDR](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/satellite-detected-water-extent-as-of-27-july-2018-over-sanamxay-district-attapeu-province-lao-)
- [Satellite detected water extent as of 30 July 2018 over Samakkhixay District, Attapeu Province, Lao PDR](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/satellite-detected-water-extent-as-of-30-july-2018-over-samakkhixay-district-attapeu-province-lao-)
- [Satellite detected water extent over Sanamxay District, Attapeu Province, Lao People Democratic Republic](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/satellite-detected-)
- [Satellite detected water extent over Sanamxay District, Attapeu Province, Lao People Democratic Republic](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/satellite-detected-water-extent-over-sanamxay-)
- [Satellite detected water extent over Sanamxay District, Attapeu Province, Lao People Democratic Republic](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/satellite-detected-water-extent-over-sanamxay-district-attapeu-province-lao-people-democratic-)
- [Time series Evolution flood satellite detected waters 13 - 29 July 2018](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/time-series-evolution-flood-satellite-detected-)
- [Time series Evolution flood satellite detected waters 13 - 29 July 2018](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/time-series-evolution-flood-satellite-detected-waters-13-29-july-2018-2830)
- [Time series: evolution satellite detected water extent over Sanamxay District, Attapeu Province, Lao PDR](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/time-series-evolution-satellite-detected-water-)
- and 1 more; the event's [catalog page](../catalog.json) lists them all.

Read [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md) for the columns and query recipes.

table:columns.name: Sensor_Dat
table:columns.description: Acquisition date of the satellite image the feature was mapped from.

table:columns.name: Area_m2
table:columns.description: Area in square metres, as UNOSAT computed it.

table:columns.name: Area_ha
table:columns.description: Area in hectares, as UNOSAT computed it.

table:columns.name: EventCode
table:columns.description: UNOSAT event code (or a Copernicus EMSR id), as recorded on the feature. It does not always equal the code of the event subcatalog.

table:columns.name: geometry
table:columns.description: Feature geometry, as UNOSAT published it (not repaired).

table:columns.name: source_layer
table:columns.description: Name of the layer in the source file that this row came from.

table:columns.name: source_file
table:columns.description: Name of the file downloaded from HDX that this row came from.

table:columns.name: bbox
table:columns.type: struct<xmin: double, ymin: double, xmax: double, ymax: double>
table:columns.description: Bounding box of the geometry (xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax), added for spatial filtering.
